items.label: Functional
items.value: This Fashion multi-functional shoulder bag comes with an adjustable strap that can be adjusted to measure 11.81 inches minimum or 21.26 inches maximum in drop length.

items.label: Structure
items.value: Internal: 1 main compartment with 1 zip pocket; This small crossbody bag can hold small essentials like phone, cards, wallet, sunglasses, cosmetics and so on.

items.label: Application
items.value: With the chain shoulder strap, it can be used as an underarm bag or a cross-body purse. Totally meet your daily needs, very lightweight and comfortable to carry.

items.label: Choice As Gift
items.value: This bag makes the gift for families, wives, friends, parents on any significant moments.

items.label: Occasion Type
items.value: Christmas, Valentines Day, Anniversary, Birthday, Shopping, Date

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Wipe with a damp cloth, avoid direct sunlight and heat, store in a cool dry place.
